title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Tuition Tax Receipts
T2202 Tuition and Enrolment Certificate tax forms are posted to
LORIS
by February 28 of each year. Once posted,
students
will be able to view and/or print their tax form (this is the government-approved form showing eligible tuition for the taxation year from LORIS.
T4A tax forms for any scholarships or bursaries received will also be posted and will be available to view and/or print on LORIS.
Other tax forms such as T4s for any income earned at Laurier are issued by Payroll and are also available to view and/or print on LORIS under the Employee tab.
These forms are not mailed.
